_comment: USD per million INPUT tokens, keyed by the telemetry 'model' field. The scorecard cost estimate uses input price only (tokens ~ prompt_chars / 4). 'default' is used for unknown models. Output prices (per MTok, not used by the estimate) for reference: opus-5 25, sonnet-5 15, fable-5 50, haiku-4-5 5. Sonnet 5 intro input price is 2.0 through 2026-08-31 (then 3.0).
